title: Network Access Boundary
problem: Self-hosted Taru needs explicit remote access policy, trusted proxy/header behavior, tunnel-provider readiness, origin constraints, and redacted diagnostics before built-in NAT traversal or broader remote-client features are safe.
gates: npm run check from apps/admin-web after Admin contract/client changes

continue_policy.notes: Network Access Boundary is complete. NAB-020 completed network access policy/config validation. NAB-030 completed request-time HTTP boundary enforcement. NAB-040 completed Admin-only network readiness diagnostics. NAB-050 closed the lane and split built-in NAT traversal runtime, relay services, client endpoint discovery, identity/RBAC, protocol downloaders, AI-assisted library ops, Addon runtime/distribution, direct library writes, Public Client API changes, and taru-client-protocol changes into dedicated follow-ons. Return to post-rpd-product-hardening; AI Assisted Library Ops is the next mainline lane.
